offers_products.reason: CLEAR+ membership, CLEAR app and CLEAR1 identity platform are software/subscription offerings; eGates are technology products.

offers_services.reason: Operates identity-verification lanes at airports and stadiums, TSA PreCheck enrollment, and Concierge VIP travel service.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Annual CLEAR+ memberships sold to travelers, with family add-ons and consumer app.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells identity verification to enterprises, airports, stadiums, rideshare and rental car companies via CLEAR1.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is annual CLEAR+ subscriptions that renew, plus enterprise platform subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Travel-linked discretionary membership; consumers can cancel or skip renewal when travel declines in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Annual membership is a modest recurring fee, small relative to traveler spending.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from biometric technology platform and kiosks/eGates network, not staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual travelers paying for memberships; enterprise and airport partners are secondary.

asset_heavy.reason: Technology platform with kiosks and eGates in partner venues; capital needs modest versus utilities or fleets.

notes: Consumer CLEAR+ memberships judged larger than enterprise identity business.
